readOnly.tooltip: Read-only in the demo. Install {{brand}} to try this for real.
readOnly.toastBody: This action is not available in the demo. Install {{brand}} to try it for real.

login.title: Explore the demo
login.description: Sign in as a read-only visitor to look around a seeded instance. Nothing you do is saved.
login.humanCheckFailed: Human verification failed. Reload the page and try again.
login.rateLimited: Too many demo sessions from your network. Wait a minute and try again.
login.failed: Could not start the demo. Try again in a moment.

unavailable.title: Not available in the demo
unavailable.terminal: The terminal and command execution run commands on a real host, so they are switched off in the demo.
unavailable.database: The database explorer and SQL console connect to a live database, so they are switched off in the demo.
unavailable.generic: This feature needs a real host, so it is switched off in the demo.
unavailable.installHint: Install {{brand}} on your own server to use it.

empty.title: Nothing here in the demo
empty.description: This area is intentionally empty in the demo data. On a real instance it fills in as you use {{brand}}.

apps.title: Your apps
apps.body: Every app, its status and its latest deploy in one list. Open one to see its logs, domains and settings.

deploys.title: Deploy history and rollback
deploys.body: Each deploy is recorded with its source and result. Any earlier version can be rolled back to in one click.

metrics.title: Metrics with deploy markers
metrics.body: Open an app and choose Metrics. Deploys are drawn on the charts, so you can see which release changed the numbers.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.body: See every server in your fleet, its capacity and what runs on it.
